name: Difficult Conversation Prep
description: Provides structured preparation frameworks for difficult conversations in personal relationships. Produces pre-conversation plans with intent clarification, anticipated responses, setting and timing recommendations, opening scripts, and de-escalation strategies. Use when the user needs to prepare for a difficult conversation with a partner, family member, friend, or other personal relationship. Do NOT use for workplace difficult conversations (use business communication skills), couples therapy preparation, or assessing relationship health.
